name: Cornelius Longinus
bio: Cornelius Longinus is one of the named epigrammatists of the Greek Anthology. Paton’s Index of Authors gives no date for him.
This archive carries the 1 epigram ascribed to the poet in the fifth volume of W. R. Paton's prose translation (Loeb, 1918): Book XVI: 117.

poems.title: Book XVI, 117: On a Painting of Cynaegirus
poems.author: Cornelius Longinus
poems.text: Phasis did not paint thee, blest Cynaegirus, as Cynaegirus, since thou hast sturdy hands in this his offering. Yet the painter was a skilful one, and did not deprive of thy hands thee who art immortal because of thy hands.
